reviews.author: Christopher Scheip
reviews.text: I came across Chris and Saul at Mountain Boys Auto Repair a little over year ago. I had an issue with my truck shifter cable. A local shop in town which I had been using for four years for all of my vehicle repairs, didn't want to work on it. Chris took care of it. He even allowed me to get my own parts. He then worked on my wife's car as the same old in town shop didn't want to work on it, again. Can you believe an auto repair shop not wanting to work on automobiles. Not Mountain Boys. Their catch phrase should "we do it right". Always prompt, courteous, and professional service from them. These two guys are very personable and it helps that their pricing is very reasonable as I am very frugal. Keep up the great work boys!

reviews.author: Nati Bernal
reviews.text: Got my car fixed here last week and I must say I am very satisfied with the work and price. Reasonably priced and quick turn over. Chris and Saul were awesome and very knowledgeable. Definitely recommend this place.

reviews.author: Crystal Hampton
reviews.text: Replace hood latch, diagnosed and fix an issue with exhaust leak, and replace valve gasket in the valve pan in 2000 Explorer. They also noticed it was low on brake fluid which they topped off and two tires that were low on air pressure. Communicated everything and charged exactly what was discussed for parts and labor. Did not have any issues with their services and will definitely use them again.

reviews.author: Jen W
reviews.text: My car left me stranded with the exact same codes 2 weeks after they fixed it. They didn't remember what they told me would need to be fixed next, and after 2 times having it towed, and then leaving it with 6 miles to empty, I'm just incredibly dissatisfied. $250 for tow bills and $300 for a fix that didn't fix anything, I'm taking my car elsewhere. They asked me for a good Google review before I even started the car. Be wary of this shop.

reviews.author: Shane Harris
reviews.text: Had a leaf spring mount rust and break off the frame of my truck. Christopher at mountain boys auto repair prepped and welded a new bracket onto the frame and got the truck back on the road in no time. Very knowledgeable mechanics will definitely be back. Would not hesitate to recommend these guys to anyone for any automotive repairs.

reviews.author: David Weber
reviews.text: Great work at a fair price. Knowledgeable,kind and easy to work with. I highly recommend Chris and Saul and will be a long time customer.

reviews.author: Rena Barnes
reviews.text: Got my oil changed in less than 10 minutes.. WOW! Excellent service.. Great price and they accommodated around my work schedule.. Thanks guys..

reviews.author: Rosa Deleon
reviews.text: I will 100% return here to these guys because every time I’ve had an issue they always help me out. They are always honest about everything too and if unable to help me out they send me in the right direction. Go check them out.

reviews.author: Jesus
reviews.text: These guys helped me out so much. They picked up and delivered my vehicle because I had no other way to get my vehicle worked on. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Dylan Romans
reviews.text: Had my Diesel worked on by these guys and they did amazing job and was very thorough on the problems. Also they cleaned my engine bay and charge pipes without asking and that just really meant a lot. Good shop and good people and great on communication.

reviews.author: W W PRESTON
reviews.text: If they can't fix it, you don't need it. These guys can repair almost anything with a motor. Pricing is transparent and very reasonable. A welcome addition to the Sparta auto repair industry.

reviews.author: James Moxley
reviews.text: I've had these guys work on my project car several times. You can't ask for 2 people with more knowledge than them. The knowledge level is on point, the way they communicate with customers is awsome and they are very affordable. My father was a Ford mechanic for 54 years (and I'll never be on his level) so I know a couple things. These men don't mess around and i trust them. So when I need work done it's going to Moutain Boys Auto Repair.

reviews.author: Jeff Revis
reviews.text: They offer quality service at affordable prices! I have dealt with them ever since they started business and I highly recommend!

reviews.author: Luke Blakeslee
reviews.text: They exceeded our expectations and really came through in a pinch for us. They diagnosed and fixed the issue quickly, and we appreciated their kindness.

reviews.author: Colleen McGhie
reviews.text: I want to take a moment to recognize this Amazing business. My daughters transmission blew in her car while we were on vacation. It took alot of research and multiple shops turning us down since her car was “challenging” to work on (2016 Nissan Rogue). These gentlemen right here were miracle workers. They were able to fix her car promptly so we could make it home on time without any issues. There communication and professionalism were phenomenal. I am ever so grateful to Christopher and his crew. Thank you again! Please keep them in mind if you have any automotive work you may need done!

reviews.author: Charlene Gould
reviews.text: Visiting from out of town when my check engine light came on the day before I had to leave. Mountain Boys took me immediately and fixed my car right up. Definitely would trust them again.

reviews.author: Mark Cory
reviews.text: Christopher and Sal did an absolute excellent job! There quick response made things seem easy, there quick turnaround got my wife's vehicle back on the road within 48hrs. Thank you guys again, much appreciated!

reviews.author: Bianca Aroche
reviews.text: I do not usually endorse a business but this place goes above and beyond to help solve any issues I have had. They explain what needs to be done and why and do not miss anything! If you want honesty and for your car to be fixed go here! I have been to every place in our area and none that explained anything like this one has.

reviews.author: Anthony San German
reviews.text: Do you have an issue with your vehicle that can’t be found?! These guys will get to the bottom of it! They are the last option when they should be the first!

reviews.author: Michelle Main
reviews.text: We were traveling through on a Saturday and called these guys. They were fabulous. They told us to come on in regardless of the fact that it was closing time. They diagnosed our issue, gave us options and were extremely kind.

reviews.author: Matthew Berry
reviews.text: Very good, transparent communication. They stayed true to the original timeline and cost that they quoted me. No issues.

reviews.author: Willow Sweeney
reviews.text: Reyes did an amazing job at getting my car up and running again and it didn’t cost me an arm and a leg. I will definitely be returning for any future work

reviews.author: Robert W. Bausum Jr.
reviews.text: Had an issue with my campers wheel bearings. They were the only shop I could find open on a Saturday. They left one guy in town near the parts store in case they needed parts to get me going. They did a fantastic job with adjusting and packing the bearings and making sure I was set for the rest of my trip. I would recommend them all day long! They were fantastic!

reviews.author: PadreDeSeis1
reviews.text: Chris was awesome in every way. Helped us out of a very tight spot while we were in town for our daughter’s wedding. Professional, efficient work at a reasonable price. Highly recommend!!!
